stop_rule: Each specification stops at first failed pre-2020/pre-2021/2023-total-decline gate; all 200 are attempted.
retention: Only gate-passed results retained. Rejected estimates/logs/models deleted; aggregate counts and predetermined plan retained.

criteria.crossing: First positive SME year precedes Large (Large may never cross)
criteria.moderation: Large-SME negative in all post years; significant all years OR significant in 2025 with p2025<=p2023
criteria.preferred: SME2025 estimate>0 and p<.05 in addition to full pattern
